blocks.text: East Newton homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

East Newton, September 2026. Detached houses: 120 listed at month end and 7 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 132 listed at month end and 11 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 39 sold over 4 months against an average of 123.5 listed, about 12.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold. Condos and townhomes: 39 sold over 4 months against an average of 132.5 listed, about 13.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold.

items.t: East Newton condos and townhomes for sale

faq.a: In Surrey's Newton community — the City describes East Newton as the neighbourhoods around Chimney Hill, east of 144 Street, north of 64 Avenue and Hyland Creek, and south of Bear Creek, planned through the East Newton North, East Newton South and East Newton Business Park NCPs.

faq.q: How did East Newton sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 120 active listings, 7 solds and a 6% sales ratio, and Condos & Townhomes recorded 132 listings, 11 solds and an 8% ratio — both in the slower half of Surrey's 15 sub-areas that month; medians are published at community level only (Surrey detached $1,215,000; attached $512,944) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What plans govern East Newton now?
faq.a: The 1990s NCPs planned the subdivisions and the area is now largely built out, but the City states East Newton North was rescinded and East Newton South's and the Business Park's designations were superseded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update — read the current OCP and Zoning Bylaw, not just the old NCP documents.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in East Newton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 120 houses listed with 7 sold in the month and 132 condos and townhomes listed with 11 sold in the month in East Newton. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is East Newton a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 6%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 8%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
